payload.purpose_context: PR #3245 unified the verdict authority model but left the write-side facade incomplete, two architectural guards partly vacuous, one latent arbiter crash, a JSON advisory gap, and a mis-pooled stress test. This brownfield hardening mission closes that leftover work and cleans the adjacent functional and technical debt without changing the (already-unified) verdict authority or read semantics.
payload.purpose_tldr: Finish the single-authority verdict boundary from PR #3245 and clear five tracked debt/bug follow-ons.

review.reference: Review passed. DEVIATION APPROVED: T024's literal instruction (flip module pytestmark fast->stress) rested on a wrong premise (it claimed the durability test was the SOLE test). File actually has 6 tests: 5 hermetic sub-second tests (T013/T014/T015) that correctly belong in fast-tests-status + 1 heavy @stress test (2 forked processes). Blanket-flipping would have swept the 5 fast tests out of the fast pool (collateral). Implementer instead excluded ONLY the heavy test via selector negation ('or stress', mirroring the existing 'and not timing' precedent), kept module mark fast, added dedicated stress-tests-serial job, and updated unit-contract-residual negation for marker-completeness. Correctly achieves #3256's goal without collateral. VERIFIED: (1) 6 tests, only test_two_concurrent_distinct_verdicts_are_both_durable carries @stress; (2) collect-only -m stress collects durability + tests/stress/test_concurrent_emits.py; fast selector over tests/status/ collects the OTHER 5 but NOT the stress one; (3) stress-tests-serial mirrors timing-nfr-serial (-n0, -m 'stress and not windows_ci', POSIX Linux, in quality-gate.needs); (4) pytest.ini:47 wording now accurate + #3256/#3235 pointers present; (5) arch suites green (test_marker_job_completeness/test_workflow_coherence/test_pytest_marker_convention: 30 passed); (6) scope = only 3 owned files; (7) YAML parses, 58 jobs; ruff clean. Anti-pattern checklist: no production code, no dead code, no frozen-surface breach, stayed in owned_files (did NOT re-home to tests/stress/).
